name: hoagiemeal
description: Meal by Hoagie — campus dining nutrition tracker for Princeton students.

CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated list of allowed CORS origins.

DATABASE_URL.description: PostgreSQL connection URL. Automatically set by the Heroku Postgres add-on.

DEBUG.description: Set to 'true' for development mode, 'false' for production.

DJANGO_SECRET_KEY.description: Django secret key used for cryptographic signing.

PROJECT_PATH.description: Path to the Django project directory for the subdirectory buildpack.

RATING_CAMPAIGN_START.description: First day (YYYY-MM-DD, campus time) of the rating raffle. Leave unset to turn it off.

RATING_CAMPAIGN_END.description: Last day (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive) of the rating raffle. Unset means no end date.

RATING_CAMPAIGN_PRIZE.description: Prize, read as 'to win <prize>', e.g. 'any Amazon item up to $100'. Empty: show the rating count only, no raffle.

RATING_CAMPAIGN_GOAL.description: Total ratings to show progress toward on the menu page. Optional.

RATING_CAMPAIGN_RATINGS_PER_TICKET.description: Dishes a student must rate in one day to earn that day's raffle ticket. Defaults to 1.
